title: 🔆🔅ARUSHA, Tanzania — The head of Iran’s parliamentary delegation to the 153rd Inter-Parliamentary Union (IPU) Assembly made remarks at an IPU general assembly session in Arusha.
text:
🔆🔅ARUSHA, Tanzania — The head of Iran’s parliamentary delegation to the 153rd Inter-Parliamentary Union (IPU) Assembly made remarks at an IPU general assembly session in Arusha."

"==================="

"SOT, Manouchehr Mottaki, Iranian MP (Farsi): "Here, as a representative of the people of Iran, I say to the people of America: your country is experiencing one of the stupidest presidents in the history of America. Donald Trump's legacy has brought war, interference, aggressive invasion, theft of the people's assets, and threats of occupying other nations' territories, from Canada to Greenland and Latin America and Asia for the world.
